bloques.titulo: Cohesion and Connectors in Formal Letters
texto: Any letter or formal mail is opened with a formula like **Sehr geehrte Damen und Herren** or **Sehr geehrte Frau Müller**. After the coma of the greeting, the body of the letter begins in tiny. To justify the reason for the message, connectors such as **deshalb**, **aus diesem Grund** or the **wegen**: **Deshalb schreibe ich Ihnen heute wegen des Termins** genitive preposition are used. The usual farewell does not have a coma: **Mit freundlichen Grüßen**.

frases.de: vielen Dank für Ihre Nachricht und Ihre Hilfe.
frases.es: Muchas gracias por su mensaje y su ayuda.
frases.en: Thank you very much for your message and your help.

frases.de: Wegen einer wichtigen Reise kann ich am Dienstag leider nicht persönlich kommen.
frases.es: Debido a un viaje importante, por desgracia no puedo acudir personalmente el martes.
frases.en: Because of a major trip, unfortunately I cannot go personally on Tuesday.

frases.de: Deshalb schreibe ich Ihnen heute wegen des Termins, denn ich muss den Termin absagen.
frases.es: Por eso le escribo hoy sobre la cita, pues tengo que cancelar la cita.
frases.en: That's why I'm writing you today about the appointment, because I have to cancel the appointment.

frases.de: Bitte schreiben Sie mir bald, wenn eine andere Zeit möglich ist.
frases.es: Por favor, escríbame pronto si otro horario es posible.
frases.en: Please write to me soon if another schedule is possible.

bloques.pregunta: After the formal greeting with coma («Sehr geehrte Frau Klein,»), how should the first word of the text begin?

opciones.texto: With a minuscule letter, unless it is a noun or pronoun that always has a capital.
opciones.explicacion: In German, after the coma of the greeting, no point is used and prayer continues in tiny.

opciones.texto: Mandatory always with initial capital in any case.
opciones.explicacion: The Spanish rule of putting two points and capital is not followed.
The German does not use signs of opening questioning.

bloques.frase: Deshalb schreibe ich Ihnen heute wegen des Termins.

opciones.texto: That's why I'm writing to you about the date today.
opciones.explicacion: Deshalb (for that reason) + schreibe ich (I write to you) + wegen des Termins (over / for the quote).

opciones.texto: That's why I didn't want to answer your last letter.
opciones.explicacion: It contrasts the communicative purpose of the phrase.

opciones.texto: I wrote him last week to confirm the appointment.
opciones.explicacion: I would express a past that has already been completed.

bloques.pregunta: What syntactic alteration does the «deshalb» ilative connector produce at the beginning of a main sentence?

opciones.texto: Provoca inversión: el verbo conjugado pasa inmediatamente a la segunda posición, antes del sujeto.
opciones.explicacion: As a conjunctive warning in position 1, «deshalb» precedes the verb («schreibe ich»).

opciones.texto: Send the conjugated verb to the absolute end of the sentence.
opciones.explicacion: That only happens with subordinate conjunctions like «weil» or «dass».

opciones.texto: It keeps the strict order of subject followed by verb unchanged.
opciones.explicacion: That would only happen with coordinating conjunctions of zero position (und, aber, denn).

bloques.frase: Wegen ___ Termins muss ich den Termin absagen.

opciones.explicacion: The «wegen» preposition is genitive; «Termin» is masculine (des Termins).
«Deshalb» occupies position 1, so the conjugated verb «schreibe» goes in position 2 before «ich».
I'd leave the verb in position 3, which is agrimatic after «deshalb».
It is the infinitive not conjugated with «ich».

bloques.pregunta: What is the canonical farewell formula in a letter or formal mail in German?

opciones.explicacion: It is the universal standard formula of epistolar courtesy.
It's an exclusive informal farewell between friends or family.
It's a personal, not protocolary, affectionate greeting.

bloques.frase: Deshalb schreibe ich Ihnen heute wegen des Termins
bloques.traduccion: That's why I'm writing to you today about the date.
bloques.explicacion: causal connector, verb in position two, formal pronoun, temporary warning and prepositional complement with genitive.

intro: The formal epistolar wording at B1 level requires a clear structure of the protocolary greeting, the reference to the subject by means of causal and ilative connectors, and an appropriate farewell.
